tooltip_fire_bomb: Instantly capture 1 small square next to your land! Available from Turn 0.
tooltip_bombardment: Capture 3 small squares at once with a bombardment! Available from Turn 10.
tooltip_soldier_spell: Bring 15 reinforcement soldiers to one of your squares! Available from Turn 12.
tooltip_mega_bomba: Capture 9 small squares at once with the Super Blast! Available from Turn 45.
tooltip_direct_laser: Fire your weapon and instantly capture 5 small squares! Available when fully charged; then a 3-turn cooldown.
error_ability_locked: This ability is not yet unlocked.
error_cooldown_active: This ability is unavailable for {turns} more turns.
shop_read_only: View only -- it is not your turn.
shop_empty: No items available for purchase right now.
tutorial_step_map: This map is Africa! The continent is made of small squares. You are the blue squares in the north, the bot is red in the south. Pinch to zoom in.
tutorial_step_territory: Select one of your squares, then tap a square next to it to attack or move soldiers. Tap your selected square again to deploy reserve soldiers.
tutorial_step_resources: At the end of each turn you earn Apples from your bases (yellow dots) and an extra soldier for every 5 squares you own.
tutorial_step_abilities: Abilities capture squares: Fire Bomb 1, Bombardment 3, Laser 5, Super Blast 9! The Soldier Spell brings soldiers.
tutorial_step_shop: Spend Apples at the Weapon Shop to buy powerful weapons.
tutorial_step_end_turn: When you are ready, press End Turn to pass control to your opponent.
tutorial_step_victory: Take every square of the bot, or conquer all of Africa, to win. Good luck!
hint_select_territory: Tap a square on the map to view its info.
hint_attack: Select your square, then tap a neighbouring square to attack or move soldiers! Tap your square again to deploy reserve soldiers.
ability_select_target: {ability}: Tap a square with an orange frame!
error_ability_not_ready: This ability is not ready yet.
error_invalid_target: This ability cannot be used there! Pick a square next to your land.
cannot_deploy: No soldiers to deploy, or the base is full!
shop_item_desc: Gives one extra use of the ability, ignoring its cooldown.
difficulty_title: How strong should the bot be?
difficulty_very_easy_desc: The bot plays slowly and shyly.
difficulty_medium_desc: The bot tries to grab land.
difficulty_hard_desc: A mighty bot! It attacks your bases and uses all its weapons.
